title: Creator profile persistence and recoverable provisioning
invariants: SeshCreatorId remains distinct from PrincipalId, legal identity, CRM identity, session identity, and profile display data.
The explicit PrincipalId to SeshCreatorId mapping remains authoritative for authenticated creator resolution.
Creator profiles are Sesh-domain records persisted in SESH_DB, not identity records in RIVER_IDENTITY_DB.
Creator profile persistence uses the canonical Sesh persistence envelope.
Creator profile creation is idempotent only when the canonical persisted profile is exactly equivalent.
Conflicting reuse of a SeshCreatorId fails closed.
No profile persistence grants project ownership, collaborator, publishing, management, copyright, legal, or payment rights.
Cross-database provisioning must be recoverable without claiming atomic transactions across RIVER_IDENTITY_DB and SESH_DB.
Live migration execution and deployment require separate fresh authorization.
